newsitem.title: POLAND: Rafako explains swing to Sept net loss.
newsitem.headline: Rafako explains swing to Sept net loss.

text.p: Polish industrial boiler maker Rafako SA said in a statement on Monday its September net loss was caused by accounting measures resulting from a revision of half-year results and increased "other-costs" during the month.
It said "other-costs" increased because settlements of long-term contracts were done in September.
Rafako swung to a 1.73 million zloty net loss in September, against a 1.76 million profit in September 1995.
In the first nine months of the year Rafako's net profit shrunk to 8.90 million zlotys from 14.32 million in the corresponding period of 1995.
On Tuesday Rafako fell 9.8 percent to 17.50 zlotys per share. Its year high was 35.00 zlotys on March 19, 1996.
